info.name: PetCare API
info.description:
Generated from docs/openapi.json.

1. Auth → Login (жюри1 / qwerty12345) or Register: saves accessToken.
2. Animals → list, Breeds → list: save animalId and breedId.
3. Pets → Create Pet saves petId; every POST saves the id of what it created.
Admin-only requests (create/update/delete animals and breeds) need a user with role ADMIN.

request.description: Seeded animals first, then the ones admins added.
Seeded breeds first, then the ones admins added.

formdata.description: jpeg, png or webp up to 5 MB

request.description: Categories are shared by all users: built-in ones first, then the ones users created.
Aggregate of one category for one pet over a period, computed by the category `kind`.
All events, latest schedule first. Health map: filter by `petId` and `type`.
Planned events due within `days`, overdue ones included, nearest first.
Setting `status` from planned to done plans the next occurrence of a repeating event.
Mark done and, for a repeating event, plan the next one. Returns both.

query.description: Only pending notifications whose time has come

request.description: Latest first. `due=true` gives what should be shown to the user right now.

For a food the pet reacted badly to: its ingredients that none of the pet's earlier tolerated foods
(isTolerability=true, fed before this one) contained. Without such foods every ingredient is a suspect.
Deletes the author's states in the category too. Refused with 409 while other users record states in it.
Pets of the breed stay, without a breed.
Deletes the animal's breeds too; pets of those breeds stay, without a breed.
